name: Firecrawl Connector
description: Read the web through the Firecrawl API: get Markdown plus HTML, links, screenshots, images, video and audio URLs, summaries or schema-shaped JSON; crawl a section, map a site, search, parse PDF/DOCX/XLSX, drive a live browser session or the browsing agent — with a spider console that shows every fetch, refusal and failure.
tab.label: Crawler
action.openConsole.label: Crawler console
prompt.console.instructions: Firecrawl runs every request on its API — this plugin has no local crawler, and it works keyless at a lower rate limit. Use firecrawl_scrape for one page, firecrawl_map to discover URLs, firecrawl_crawl for several pages, firecrawl_batch_scrape for a known URL list, firecrawl_search when the user wants a web search first, firecrawl_extract for structured data, firecrawl_parse to read a local PDF/DOCX/XLSX as Markdown, and firecrawl_video to get a signed media URL for a page. Long jobs return a job id: follow it with firecrawl_job_status, and use firecrawl_monitor for recurring checks. Keep defaults unless the user asks for more, and report the upstream error when a request is refused.
